params.body:
The menu was one row of ten items: Dag, Inzichten, Catalogus, Ploeg, Gebruikers, Werf-app, Verkennen, Netwerk, Overdracht, Medewerkers. Nothing said which belong to the worksheets and which to the handover.

This PR contains #112 (the user menu), because both rewrite the header. Merging this one is enough.

## What changes

- **Two groups, each under a small label:**
  - **Werkfiches:** Dag, Inzichten, Catalogus, Ploeg, and the Werf-app button (and "Demo resetten" while the demo switch is on).
  - **Overdracht:** Verkennen, Netwerk, Bespreken, Medewerkers.

  A thin rule separates them. Somebody on a shared link sees the Overdracht group only.
- **"Overdracht" becomes "Bespreken".** The menu item, the page title and its heading change, so the group label is not repeated as an item. The page is the list to talk through and what was told.
- **Gebruikers moves to the user menu**, under the name with its chevron (from #112), for admins: it is a setting, not daily work. Under it are the address, Gebruikers and Afmelden.

## Tests

- `MenuGroupsTest`:
  - an admin sees both groups in order, and Gebruikers in the user menu; an office user does not see it;
  - a shared link sees only the Overdracht group.
- `UserMenuTest` (from #112).
- Full suite 306/306.
- Checked in headless Chromium: the two labelled groups, and the open user menu.
